title: Lily Learns to Help Her Friends

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's a sunny day at the park! And look, there's a new friend!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Hi! I'm Lily! I'm building the biggest sandcastle in the whole park!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Pat, pat, pat! Scoop, scoop, scoop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Here comes Mila, with a basket of apples.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh no! Bump! The apples roll everywhere!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Oh! Lily, can you help me pick them up?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Sorry, I'm busy. I'm building my castle.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then Leo runs by with his kite. Whoosh! It flies up... and gets stuck in the tree!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: My kite! Lily, can you help me?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Not now. It's not my kite.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And here is Bobo, carrying a big, heavy box of toys.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Huff, puff! This box is so heavy! Can somebody help me?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: I'm busy, Bobo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Mila, Leo and Bobo feel sad. Nobody helped them.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Hmm. Was Lily being a good friend?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Not really. She was so busy, she forgot about her friends.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then... a big gust of wind! Whoosh! Lily's bucket and spade blow away, and her castle falls down!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Oh no! My castle! My bucket!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: I can't fix it all by myself!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Don't worry, Lily! We'll help you!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I'll catch the bucket!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: And I'll find the spade!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Everybody helps. Pat, pat, scoop! The castle is back, even bigger!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: You helped me... but I didn't help you. Why did you help me?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Because friends help friends!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: I'm sorry. I was too busy. I want to help too! But how?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hoo hoo! I can show you, Lily! Helping is easy, in three little steps.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step one: Look. Look around. Does a friend have a problem? Are they sad?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you look around with big eyes? Look, look!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step two: Ask. Say, can I help you?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you say it? Can I help you?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step three: Help! Do a little thing to make it better.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you give a big thumbs up? Let's help!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Look. Ask. Help. I can do it!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's practise! What can we do to help?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A friend dropped her crayons. Can you pick them up? Pick, pick, pick!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Great helping!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A friend is sad. Can you give a big, warm hug?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Aww! What a lovely hug!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A friend's tower fell down. Can you build it up again? Stack, stack, stack!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Oops! I'm hugging the tower! Hee hee!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And a friend is sitting all alone. Can you wave and say, come and play?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Come and play with us!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, Lily wants to help her friends.

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Look! Mila's apples are still on the grass!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Mila, can I help you?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Yes, please!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's count the apples together! One, two, three, four, five!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Thank you, Lily!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Look! Leo's kite is still stuck. Leo, can I help you?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can they get the kite down? Hmm...

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! I'll jump really, really high!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Boing! Boing! Leo can't reach it.

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Let's wait for the wind, and pull the string together, gently!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One, two, three... pull! Gently, gently!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The wind blows, and the kite floats free! Hooray!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Thank you, Lily!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: And Bobo! Can I help you carry the box?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Lily holds one side, Bobo holds the other. Heave, ho! Heave, ho!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: It's so light now! Thank you, Lily!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then all four friends build a castle together. The biggest castle ever!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Helping my friends feels so good! My heart is happy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When we help our friends, everybody is happy, even us!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who will YOU help today?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember! Are you ready?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What was Lily building?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: The biggest sandcastle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What happened when the wind came?

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: My castle fell down, and my friends helped me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What are the three helping steps?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look! Ask! Help!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Did jumping high get the kite down?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: No! Silly me! We pulled it gently, together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Look!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Ask!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Help!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Look! Ask! Help!

vo.speaker: lily
vo.text: Bye bye, friends! Be a helper!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
